title: Introduction to AI and Programming
instructor: Chad Jenkins (Lead Course Creator); Jana Pavlasek (Co-Lead)
weeklyTopics: Introductory artificial intelligence concepts and algorithms
Applying AI concepts on real robots
workloadNotes: 5 programming projects (graded via GitHub Classroom, feature-based checked/due grading), 4 quizzes, in-class activities via Replit, and participation. Flipped-classroom format with pre-recorded lectures. Satisfies intro programming requirement for several engineering majors (BME, CS-Engin, CS-LSA, NAME, Robotics) in place of Engin 101/151, and a prerequisite for EECS 280.
prerequisitesText: None; expected to be fluent in algebra and willing to think algorithmically.
